name: Stun
description: Stun is a Status Effect in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. A Stunned Character will not be able to play their turn.

name: Blight
description: Blight is a Status Effect in Clair Obscur Expedition 33. Blight reduces the afflicted Character's maximum Health, which can stack repeatedly.

name: Berserk

name: Cursed
